tagline: We help pediatricians pass the boards, even if they've been struggling for years.
title: Meet our founder,
name: Ashish Goyal
bio: After failing his pediatric boards, Dr. Ashish Goyal completely restructured his studying technique to embrace a new style of learning that was focused on efficiency and repetition. As a result, he increased his score by 40%, and was invited by the ABP to write board questions for them. That led Ashish to begin a journey that has helped thousands of pediatricians pass their board exams through Pediatrics Board Review®.
